name: Maua
source:
A waitress at the Mandrill bar. She is an intelligent woman with a relaxed atmosphere.

A native of the mining town of Hyde, she has dreamt of opening a store selling rare goods in a strange city since she was a child, having heard stories of rare items and foreign cities from the peddlers who visited her town. Now, having turned 18, she visited the harbor city of Belford as the first step toward her dream.

[translated from [url=http://dl.getchu.com/i/item1000683]Getchu[/url]]
